ci_support_linux_64_CLANG_VERSION21.1MSV:
CHOST:
- x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
CLANG_VERSION:
- '21.1'
FINAL_CFLAGS:
- -ftree-vectorize -fstack-protector-strong -O2 -ffunction-sections -pipe -march=nocona
  -mtune=haswell
FINAL_CL_FLAGS:
- /Oi /O2 /GS /Gy /MD -fuse-ld=lld -march=nocona -mtune=haswell
FINAL_CXXFLAGS:
- -fvisibility-inlines-hidden -std=c++17 -fmessage-length=0 -ftree-vectorize -fstack-protector-strong
  -O2 -ffunction-sections -pipe -march=nocona -mtune=haswell
MSVC_HEADERS_VERSION:
- 14.29.30133
RUNTIME_VERSION:
- 14.29.30139
TOOLCHAIN_COMBINED:
- 14.29.16.11
VCVER:
- '14.2'
WINSDK_URL:
- https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2326092
WINSDK_VERSION:
- 10.0.26100.0
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cross_target_platform:
- win-64
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - VCVER
  - RUNTIME_VERSION
  - TOOLCHAIN_COMBINED
  - MSVC_HEADERS_VERSION

about.description:
To use this package in a normal conda environment, do the following

   export CONDA_BUILD_WINSDK=/opt

To use this package in a conda-build environment, add the following

   CONDA_BUILD_WINSDK:
     - "/opt"

in $HOME/conda_build_config.yaml and use `clang_win-64` or `clang_win-arm64`
as the compiler.

By setting this variable, you are agreeing to the terms and conditions
of the Windows SDK and the MSVC headers. If the Windows SDK and MSVC
headers are not inside CONDA_BUILD_WINSDK, they would be automatically
downloaded.
about.summary: Scripts to download Windows SDK headers

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  # versions
  CLANG_VERSION: ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}
  VCVER: ${{ VCVER }}
  vc_major: ${{ VCVER | split(".") | first | int }}
  VSYEAR: ${{ VSYEAR if win else "1999" }}
  MSVC_HEADERS_VERSION: ${{ MSVC_HEADERS_VERSION if unix else "1.0" }}
  WINSDK_VERSION: ${{ WINSDK_VERSION if unix else "1.0" }}

  # other variables
  cross_target_platform: ${{ cross_target_platform }}
  CHOST: ${{ CHOST }}
  FINAL_CFLAGS: ${{ FINAL_CFLAGS }}
  FINAL_CL_FLAGS: ${{ FINAL_CL_FLAGS }}
  FINAL_CXXFLAGS: ${{ FINAL_CXXFLAGS }}
  TOOLCHAIN_COMBINED: ${{ TOOLCHAIN_COMBINED if unix else "" }}
  WINSDK_URL: ${{ WINSDK_URL if unix else "" }}

  # build numbers
  build_number: 27
  # separate builds number for headers & winsdk; reset when version increases (resp. all relevant versions)
  headers_build_number: 6
  winsdk_build_number: 1

recipe:
  name: clang-win-activation
  version: "${{ CLANG_VERSION }}"

source:
  # not the main source, but a very useful download utility to determine
  # necessary download urls of windows artefacts, see install-pkg.sh
  - url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mstorsjo/msvc-wine/635a3aa148a42f701b3e46dd13791a01a3cf87f6/vsdownload.py
    sha256: d33edb859d7b17ec1350f2b8c5dca8b7aa39375a4d206e2e8eef3fb95848c0b2
    patches:
      - patches/0001-show-payload-url.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  # for win-arm64, only build native clang compilers for now
  skip: (target_platform == "win-arm64" or cross_target_platform == "win-arm64") and target_platform != cross_target_platform

outputs:
  - package:
      name: winsdk
      version: ${{ WINSDK_VERSION }}
    build:
      skip: win
      number: ${{ winsdk_build_number }}
      string: ${{ winsdk_build_number }}
      script:
        file: install-pkg
        env:
          cross_target_platform: ${{ cross_target_platform }}
          CHOST: ${{ CHOST }}
          FINAL_CFLAGS: ${{ FINAL_CFLAGS }}
          WINSDK_URL: ${{ WINSDK_URL }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - sed
      host:
      run:
        - curl *
        - msitools
        - p7zip
    tests:
      - script:
          env:
            # see https://github.com/prefix-dev/rattler-build/issues/2781
            CI: "yup, it's CI"
          # see https://github.com/prefix-dev/rattler-build/issues/2782
          file: run_test_hello
    about:
      license: LicenseRef-MICROSOFT-SDK
      license_file: LICENSE_SDK.txt
      summary: "Scripts to download Windows SDK headers"

  - package:
      name: msvc-headers-libs
      version: ${{ MSVC_HEADERS_VERSION }}
    build:
      skip: win
      number: ${{ headers_build_number }}
      string: ${{ headers_build_number }}
      script:
        file: install-pkg
        env:
          cross_target_platform: ${{ cross_target_platform }}
          TOOLCHAIN_COMBINED: ${{ TOOLCHAIN_COMBINED }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - python *
        - six
        - grep
        - ripgrep
        - sed
      host:
      run:
        - unzip
        - curl *
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - python_abi
    tests:
      - script:
          env:
            CI: "yup, it's CI"
          file: run_test_hello
    about:
      license: LicenseRef-MSVC-HEADERS
      license_file: LICENSE_MSVC_HEADERS.txt
      summary: "Scripts to download MSVC headers and libraries"

  - package:
      name: clang_${{ cross_target_platform }}
    build:
      script:
        file: install-pkg
        env:
          cross_target_platform: ${{ cross_target_platform }}
          CHOST: ${{ CHOST }}
          FINAL_CFLAGS: ${{ FINAL_CFLAGS }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: unix
          then: sed
          else: m2-sed
      host:
        # Needed to create the symlinks
        - clang       ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
        - llvm-tools  ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
      run:
        - if: unix
          then:
            - ${{ pin_subpackage("msvc-headers-libs", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
            - ${{ pin_subpackage("winsdk", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
          else:
            - vs${{ VSYEAR }}_${{ cross_target_platform }} ==${{ CL_VERSION }}
            - vswhere
        - clang                                     ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
        - llvm-tools                                ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
        - lld                                       ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
        - compiler-rt                               ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
        - compiler-rt_${{ cross_target_platform }}  ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
        - if: linux
          then: gcc_impl_${{ target_platform }}
        - if: osx
          then: clang_impl_${{ target_platform }}
      run_exports:
        strong:
          - vc >=${{ VCVER }}
          - vc${{ vc_major }}_runtime >=${{ RUNTIME_VERSION }}
          # Need ucrt for windows<10 and when the VC runtime does not bundle it
          - ucrt >=10.0.20348.0
    tests:
      - requirements:
          run:
            - cmake
            - ninja
        files:
          recipe:
            - cmake_test_c/
            - test.c
            - if: unix
              then: run_test_clang.sh
              else: run_test_clang.bat
        script:
          env:
            CI: "yup, it's CI"
          file: run_test_clang

  - package:
      name: clangxx_${{ cross_target_platform }}
    build:
      script:
        file: install-pkg
        env:
          cross_target_platform: ${{ cross_target_platform }}
          CHOST: ${{ CHOST }}
          FINAL_CXXFLAGS: ${{ FINAL_CXXFLAGS }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: unix
          then: sed
          else: m2-sed
      host:
        # Needed to create the symlinks
        - clangxx     ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
        - llvm-tools  ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("clang_" ~ cross_target_platform, exact=True) }}
        - clangxx     ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
        - if: linux
          then: gxx_impl_${{ target_platform }}
        - if: osx
          then: clangxx_impl_${{ target_platform }}
      run_exports:
        strong:
          - vc >=${{ VCVER }}
          - vc${{ vc_major }}_runtime >=${{ RUNTIME_VERSION }}
          # Need ucrt for windows<10 and when the VC runtime does not bundle it
          - ucrt >=10.0.20348.0
    tests:
      - requirements:
          run:
            - cmake
            - ninja
        files:
          recipe:
            - cmake_test_cxx/
            - test.cpp
            - if: unix
              then: run_test_clangxx.sh
              else: run_test_clangxx.bat
        script:
          env:
            CI: "yup, it's CI"
          file: run_test_clangxx

  # msvc compatibility mode; only makes sense on windows;
  # no distinction between C/C++ because "clangxx-cl" exists nowhere
  - package:
      name: clang-cl_${{ cross_target_platform }}
    build:
      skip: not win
      script:
        file: install-pkg
        env:
          cross_target_platform: ${{ cross_target_platform }}
          FINAL_CL_FLAGS: ${{ FINAL_CL_FLAGS }}
          FINAL_CXXFLAGS: ${{ FINAL_CXXFLAGS }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - m2-sed
      host:
        # Needed to create the symlinks
        - clang       ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
        - llvm-tools  ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
      run:
        - vs${{ VSYEAR }}_${{ cross_target_platform }} ==${{ CL_VERSION }}
        - vswhere
        - clang                                     ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
        - llvm-tools                                ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
        - lld                                       ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
        - compiler-rt                               ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
        - compiler-rt_${{ cross_target_platform }}  ${{ CLANG_VERSION }}.*
      run_exports:
        strong:
          - vc >=${{ VCVER }}
          - vc${{ vc_major }}_runtime >=${{ RUNTIME_VERSION }}
          # Need ucrt for windows<10 and when the VC runtime does not bundle it
          - ucrt >=10.0.20348.0
      run_constraints:
        # avoid conflicating activations
        - clang_${{ cross_target_platform }} <0.0a0
    tests:
      - requirements:
          run:
            - cmake
            - ninja
            # flang 23 not built yet
            - if: match(CLANG_VERSION, "<23") and not (win and arm64)
              then: flang_${{ cross_target_platform }}
        files:
          recipe:
            - cmake_test_c/
            - cmake_test_cxx/
            - test.c
            - test.cpp
            - run_test_clang.bat
            - run_test_clangxx.bat
            - sanitycheckf.f
        script:
          - run_test_clang.bat
          - run_test_clangxx.bat
          # flang 23 not built yet
          - if: match(CLANG_VERSION, "<23") and not (win and arm64)
            then: "flang-new sanitycheckf.f -o sanitycheckf.exe %FFLAGS% %LDFLAGS%"

about:

  license: BSD-3-Clause

  summary: 'clang (cross) compiler for windows with MSVC ABI compatbility'

         - "/opt"

    in $HOME/conda_build_config.yaml and use `clang_win-64` or `clang_win-arm64`

    of the Windows SDK and the MSVC headers. If the Windows SDK and MSVC
    headers are not inside CONDA_BUILD_WINSDK, they would be automatically
    downloaded.
